title: web UI: make card status controls contextual, not a wrap-around cycle
description: The Advance status button (pkg/webui/assets/app.js nextStatus/advanceStatus) cycles draft -> open -> inprogress -> blocked -> closed -> draft. Two bad outcomes: advancing an inprogress task lands on blocked (a regression state nobody wants from an Advance action), and advancing a closed task wraps back to draft. Replace the single cycling button with meaningful actions (e.g. Start / Done plus an explicit status menu) so blocked is only reachable deliberately and closed never wraps. Update the help dialog shortcuts to match.
